title: Generalising from Self-Produced Data: Model Training Beyond Human Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2504.04711v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current large language models (LLMs) are constrained by human-derived training data and limited by a single level of abstraction that impedes definitive truth judgments. This paper introduces a novel framework in which AI models autonomously generate and validate new knowledge through direct interaction with their environment. Central to this approach is an unbounded, ungamable numeric reward - such as annexed disk space or follower count - that guides learning without requiring human benchmarks. AI agents iteratively generate strategies and executable code to maximize this metric, with successful outcomes forming the basis for self-retraining and incremental generalisation. To mitigate model collapse and the warm start problem, the framework emphasizes empirical validation over textual similarity and supports fine-tuning via GRPO. The system architecture employs modular agents for environment analysis, strategy generation, and code

translated_title: 从自产数据中泛化：超越人类约束的模型训练
translated_abstract: 当前的大型语言模型（LLM）受限于源自人类的训练数据，并受制于单一的抽象层次，这阻碍了确定性的真值判断。本文引入了一个新颖的框架，其中AI模型通过与环境的直接交互自主生成并验证新知识。该方法的核心是一个无界的、不可被博弈的数值奖励——例如附加的磁盘空间或粉丝数量——它在无需人类基准的情况下引导学习。AI智能体迭代地生成策略和可执行代码以最大化该指标，成功的成果则构成自再训练和增量泛化的基础。为缓解模型崩溃和热启动问题，该框架强调经验验证而非文本相似性，并支持通过GRPO进行微调。系统架构采用模块化智能体进行环境分析、策略生成和代码执行。
tldr: 本文提出一个让AI通过与环境的直接交互，以无界且不可博弈的数值奖励自主生成并验证知识的新框架，实现自再训练与增量泛化，从而突破人类训练数据的约束。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework enabling AI models to autonomously generate and validate knowledge through direct environment interaction, guided by an unbounded, ungamable numeric reward, achieving self-retraining and incremental generalization beyond human-derived training constraints.
